title: draw_messages allocates Vec<Line> for ALL messages on every 50ms tick
description: In draw_messages, lines is built by collecting ALL state.messages into a Vec<Line> on every draw, then only a visible_height slice is scrolled into view by Paragraph::scroll(). With 500 messages this allocates 500 Line objects, 500 Span objects, and 500 &str references on every 50ms tick = 20 allocations/second * 500 = 10,000 small allocations/sec in steady state. The fix is to slice messages to only the visible window before building Lines: state.messages.iter().skip(top).take(visible_height). This is already tracked as KITH-hqrw.42.
